findings.finding: The positive D12 gesture case unconditionally expects modifier-Y to change Filter Width, but never selects a nonzero Noise Blend. The common prerequisites record modes and disallow assumed defaults; they do not select an enabled width state. The same retained manual explicitly says Filter Width is grayed out at Noise Blend0%. Thus a permitted initial state enters a documented disabled branch, for which modifier-drag updating the stored parameter has not been established. Recording current state or audio P-AUDIO prerequisites does not close this UI-state condition.
findings.requested_change: Set and verify an accepted nonzero Noise Blend (for example the already requested100% endpoint) before the positive modifier-Y branch. Keep the sine-only disabled state as a separate case and leave whether its XY gesture can update an inactive stored value U unless separately evidenced. Update JSON/rendered row and freeze a new revision; preserve r1.

findings.finding: DST-EROSION-006 requests identical-channel S1 for its Stereo Width probe, but S1 is dual mono only in the first second. The second second uses different channel frequencies/amplitudes and the third is opposite-polarity. Using the full defined signal does not supply the named dual-mono baseline. Its null U oracle correctly prevents a false compatibility pass, but the intended finite input is ambiguous.
findings.requested_change: Choose S1 first-second segment explicitly, or retain a separately named L=R variant with duration, amplitudes and channel formula pinned. Retain independently established width-sensitive modulation/processed-output requirements and null oracle.
